description: ChatGPT Plugin for DBBS Project Scope Generator turns a one-paragraph software project idea into a free, branded Scope Document — a multi-page PDF with an executive summary, functional and non-functional requirements, an architecture outline, ADRs, a milestone plan, team setup, and a risk register. Describe your project, and it drafts the document in the background (usually 5–10 minutes); check the status to get a direct download link, or have it emailed to you as a secure download link with your consent. The document never contains pricing or hour estimates. Built by DBB Software, a senior software engineering partner.
